description:
Get ledger entries / journal (asientos) for a date range (Holded API v2, GET /ledger-entries). Returns one row per ledger line with entryNumber, line, timestamp, type (collect/payment/purchase/…), description, account (PGC num), debit, and credit. This is the authoritative source for balance-sheet and tax-return figures. 

Date arguments (at least one form of each bound is required — the v2 API returns 422 without both):
  • Primary form  : `start_date` / `end_date` — ISO 8601 date strings (YYYY-MM-DD)
  • Legacy form   : `starttmp` / `endtmp` — Unix timestamps in seconds; converted automatically to ISO

If both forms are supplied for the same bound, the ISO string takes precedence.

Cursor-paginated: pass `nextCursor` from a previous response as `cursor` to retrieve subsequent pages. Large date ranges may require multiple pages. Set `groupByEntry` to nest lines into full double-entry entries with per-entry debit/credit totals (applied page-scoped). 
See also: `list_ledger_entries` in ledger tools — both tools target the same v2 endpoint. Read-only.

cursor.description: Cursor token from a previous response nextCursor

end_date.description: Range end as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Required unless endtmp is provided.

endtmp.description: Range end as a Unix timestamp in seconds (legacy form, converted to ISO). Use end_date when possible.

groupByEntry.description: Group lines by entryNumber into full journal entries (each with totalDebit/totalCredit), applied to the current page. Default: false (flat lines)

limit.description: Max items per cursor page (server-paginated; use limit to control page size)

start_date.description: Range start as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Required unless starttmp is provided.

starttmp.description: Range start as a Unix timestamp in seconds (legacy form, converted to ISO). Use start_date when possible.

name: get_daily_ledger
